answer: A concrete defense is raven-window scheduling: each epoch, a raven oracle draws scarce work windows from a mesa-bounded capacity table, assigning them by credential hash; delivery counts only inside its window against a quartz token bound to that window. Windows are capped below demand, and newcomers claim leftovers by posting quartz deposits scaling with window pressure. A clone flood competes for the same scarce windows and pays escalating deposits, while out-of-window work earns nothing and is logged. Honest agents work their window and get the deposit back.
